item.title: Former New England Patriots Tight End Benjamin Watson on the Growing Trend of Pro Athletes Openly Sharing Their Faith
item.description: Former New England Patriots tight end Benjamin Watson explains why more pro athletes are openly sharing their faith.

item.title: Mike Winger Offers $100K To Investigate Faith Healer Todd White
item.description: Calling Todd White a “fraud,” Mike Winger offered up to $100,000 for a “proper, good, independent investigation” into the faith healer.

item.title: Trump Tells National Prayer Breakfast He ‘Probably Should Make It’ to Heaven for Doing ‘A Hell of a Lot of Good’
item.description: During the National Prayer Breakfast, President Donald Trump said he “probably should make it” to heaven and that a past comment was a joke.

item.title: Compassion International Partners With Sports Spectrum to Highlight Faith-Filled Athletes During Super Bowl Week
item.description: Compassion International is using Super Bowl week to highlight faith-driven athletes and partnerships rooted in the local church and the gospel of Jesus Christ.

item.title: ‘I Lost Everything’—Former Newsboys Singer John James Talks Redemption, New Book, New Music, and Michael Tait
item.description: John James, former Newsboys co-founder, reflects on losing everything, God’s redemption, the local church, new music and his response to Michael Tait.

item.title: Former Texas Pastor, in Prison for Child Porn, Sued by 14 Women Depicted in CSAM
item.description: A group of 14 women sued a former Texas pastor who pleaded guilty in 2023 to an “enhanced charge of possession of child pornography.”

item.title: ‘Racist,’ ‘Vile,’ ‘Wicked’—Christian Leaders Condemn Trump’s Truth Social Post Depicting the Obamas as Apes
item.description: President Donald Trump has sparked outrage because of a video posted to his Truth Social account depicting Barack and Michelle Obama as apes.

item.title: Bethany Dearborn Hiser: When Helping Others Is Driven by the Need To Be Needed
item.description: Bethany Dearborn Hiser joins Jason Daye to explore the often-overlooked reality of secondary trauma in ministry.

item.title: 3 Doors Down Singer Brad Arnold Dies at 47 After Publicly Sharing His Faith During Cancer Battle
item.description: 3 Doors Down lead singer Brad Arnold has died at 47 after battling cancer. The rocker publicly shared his faith and trust in God.

item.title: ‘Jesus Is the Only Way’—Tony Dungy Joins Sean Feucht at Super Bowl Jesus March
item.description: Tony Dungy joined Sean Feucht at the Super Bowl Jesus March in San Francisco, sharing a powerful message that “Jesus is the only way.”
